model.name: Ground-station 5-element Yagi (867 MHz)
model.description: Five-element Yagi-Uda for a ground station in the 863-870 MHz SRD / LoRa band: a reflector, a straight driven dipole with a hairpin (beta) match and three directors on a 283 mm non-metal boom (x, +x forward). The elements stand vertical (z) for vertical polarisation, to match a UAV's vertical dipole. Each 4 mm rod is modelled as a PEC strip twice its diameter wide (8 mm) in the xz plane, the equivalent of a round rod. The spacings and lengths start from the NBS 5-element design (0.8 wavelength boom), re-optimised for front-to-back ratio. A 50 ohm lumped port across the 6 mm feed gap stands for the balun output (the feed is balanced: use a 1:1 balun in practice); the hairpin, a shorted strip-pair stub behind the driven element, and the driven element length together set the 50 ohm match. About 10.4 dBi, front-to-back ratio 18.6 dB, |S11| below -20 dB over 863-870 MHz. Its tuning, its results and how to scale it to other bands are described with the example designs in the Fairbeam documentation.
